title: Lamb of God
gist: John the Baptist points to Jesus and says 'Behold the Lamb of God, who takest away the sin of the world.' Several Old Testament lambs lie behind it: the Passover lamb whose blood saved Israel, the daily offering in the Temple, Isaac's ram, and the silent lamb of Isaiah 53. At Mass the people hear these words before Communion.

passages.note: 'He was led as a sheep to the slaughter.'
